meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 就能操作浏览器:打开网页、点击、截图等;也可以分步完成填表、抓数据等浏览器任务,过程中页面状态会保留不丢失。默认新开一个独立浏览器窗口;也可改用扩展模式,连到你正在用的 Chrome 去操作已登录的网站。
howto.when: 当用户提到“打开网址”“点击”“截图”等,或提出填表、抓取数据、测试网站等浏览器操作请求时,会接管浏览器操作。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截取整页截图。
say.note: 会自动访问页面,并把截图保存成文件。

say.text: 在搜索框输入“AI 新闻”并点击搜索。
say.note: 脚本会完成输入和点击,并返回页面结果。

say.text: 连到我已登录的浏览器,打开订单页并截图。
say.note: 扩展模式会操作你正在用的 Chrome 会话。

howto.what_en: Claude can drive a browser to open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots and scrape data. Page state persists between steps. It launches a fresh Chromium by default, or can attach to your existing Chrome (extension mode).
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions "go to [url]", "click", or "take a screenshot", or asks for any browser interaction such as filling forms, scraping data, testing a website, or automating a workflow.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a full-page screenshot.
say_en.note: Starts a browser, loads the page, and saves the image.

say_en.text: Type "AI news" into the search box and hit search.
say_en.note: Fills the input, clicks search, and reports the result.

say_en.text: Use my logged-in browser to open the order page and screenshot it.
say_en.note: Extension mode drives your real Chrome session.
